## Context
This cohort contains explanatory comments that mix current contracts with repetition, narration, or history. The audit was pinned to `9e65567b79ffe872534c3c656ade7b34340d8192` and revalidated against `origin/main` at `9d5a7278c892519542c582c77968c007213f0708`; the 18 target files are unchanged since the detailed review at `c019920390926d543a0813d4c0c8721543d98776`.

## Approach
Edit standalone explanatory comments only. Keep current non-obvious rationale, security boundaries, failure semantics, portability constraints, and operator-visible contracts. Do not alter workflow data, shell, expressions, permissions, triggers, action pins, assertions, or user-facing output.

These behavior-bearing directive lines must remain exact:
- `_artifact-probe.yml:79,94`: `# shellcheck disable=SC1091`
- `_mutation.yml:153` and `gerrit-verify.yaml:508,536,580`: `# predates-gate-ok:` markers
- `gerrit-verify.yaml:515` and `prompt-eval.yml:77`: complete `# mechanism-ok: ci_gate …` markers

## Scope
- `_artifact-probe.yml:3-94` — Preserve secret-free reusable branch/Gerrit exact-patchset checkout, sdist-first wheel build, baked commit and metadata checks, installed archive probes, schema/import walk, and shellcheck directives.
- `_build-and-test.yml:3-939` — Preserve secret-free exact checkout; online-token versus portable local lint; pre-commit skips; old-patchset guards; ownership-routed dependency advisories; enforced privileged-container sandbox proof; Linux/macOS matrix, coverage lane, required extras and portable Node setup; local-only browser-tier opt-out record; patchset pytest timeout, integration isolation, Gerrit-only report coverage, trusted-main docs restore, and generated/parity/security gates.
- `_eval-discipline.yml:3-74` — Preserve both callers, secret/model-free exact-patchset evaluation, named offline subset, and 300-second thread timeout.
- `_mutation.yml:59-155` — Preserve changed/all shard selection, empty-selection skip, 30-minute shards, always-uploaded evidence, the hosted-Ubuntu user-namespace waiver, and exact predates marker.
- `_optionality.yml:3-281` — Preserve fork-safe secret-free checkout; clean no-extra wheel and heavy-dependency absence; old-patchset presence guards; real no-agents degradation; fresh per-extra environments, union resolution, absolute interpreters, and aggregated failure.
- `codeql.yml:3-56` — Preserve schedule/manual-only triggering, six-hour staggering, same-ref cancellation, Python/JavaScript matrix, path config, top-level read-only permissions with job-local security-event write, and intentional major action tags.
- `compact-sweep.yml:1-190` — Preserve out-of-band six-hour/manual single flight; full-history ticket merge (never rebase); harmless 60-minute bound; sweep-only write permission; optional 0600 signing key; dry-run/limit inputs; exit 2 warning versus exit 1 failure; no-pipe output capture; always-written summary and failure annotation; operation-linked no-CI fallback. It publishes no metrics.
- `dependency-advisory-canary.yml:1-180` — Preserve daily/manual dry-run, 20-minute single flight, writable full-history store, optional signing, deduplicated lifecycle and 24-hour comment cap, release-only blocking, merge-not-rebase retry flush, and visible red result. The audit step remains `continue-on-error` for escalation; the alert step must not, so a crash with no outputs fails closed.
- `external-integration.yml:3-904` — Preserve manual/weekly billable boundary; per-provider isolation and loud missing-credential/all-skip failure; Bedrock-only OIDC exchange and both region variables; complementary partitions, per-test timeouts, usage evidence; ephemeral Langfuse readiness/teardown; amd64 Jira DC evidence/teardown; scoped S3 rehearsal cleanup; single run-labelled Jira Cloud mutation cleanup; and Linux/macOS Pandoc replay.
- `gerrit-verify.yaml:3-624` — Preserve run-name as authoritative patchset identity; exact patchset checkout; trusted-main classifier, normalizer, and vote code; secret confinement; docs-only/full route exclusivity; complete `vote.needs`, fail-closed conclusion mapping, closed-change race handling; observability steps that cannot affect the vote; and exact policy markers.
- `jira-dc-capability-map.yml:3-108` — Preserve manual amd64 authoring run, digest-pinned shared harness, required Anthropic access, one 900-step agent run, read-only repository ticket store, always teardown, and required artifact. Disposable Jira may be mutated by experiments.
- `jira-dc-epic-link-probe.yml:3-44` — Preserve manual deterministic stdlib/four-call write-and-clear probe against disposable Jira, no LLM, pinned harness, no repository/ticket-store mutation, always teardown, and required artifact.
- `jira-dc-exact-patchset.yml:3-170` — Preserve nine-input manual lane; mirror-first/Gerrit-fallback exact ref fetch and SHA verification; mismatch/all-skip failure; required DC extra; isolated no-remotes/push-off suite; always teardown; additive non-Verified role. Evidence is in summary, environment, and logs; no artifact is uploaded.
- `jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml:3-106` — Preserve manual Anthropic root-cause run, shared harness, dev/DC extras, direct-Anthropic overlay, read-only repository ticket store, 600 steps/1800-second timeout, evidence upload, and always teardown. It may write disposable Jira.
- `mirror-guard.yml:3-50` — Preserve 15-minute/manual replication-only checks, multiple samples before failure, public/default-token reads, same-ref cancellation, and deliberate exclusion of admin-read ruleset drift.
- `optionality.yml:3-32` — Preserve mirror caller filters, all pull requests, manual and staggered six-hour branch health, read-only/no-vote posture, and branch-head reusable invocation.
- `prompt-eval.yml:3-136` — Preserve offline branch/PR/manual evaluation; advisory changed-rubric live evaluation for same-repo changes; canonical-repo weekly/manual full live evaluation; sequential cases, per-spec cap 12, provider-owned dollar caps, usage summaries/artifacts, branch concurrency, and exact mechanism marker.
- `reconcile-bridge-canary.yml:1-218` — Preserve status-source/default rollback input, two-hour cadence/four-hour window, 10-minute single flight, contents-write/actions-read, full-history ticket ref, 0600 signing key, init, consecutive-red deduplicated lifecycle, read-only binding fsck, strict synchronous merge-not-rebase push, dry-run, and terminal stale red.

Paths are relative to `.github/workflows/`. GitHub Actions, repository policy tests, bridge code, and operators are the consumers.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] The final diff changes only standalone explanatory comments or blank lines in the 18 declared files.
- [ ] Every Scope contract remains explicit and accurate in the resulting file or its authoritative linked documentation.
- [ ] Every exact directive listed above remains byte-for-byte present.
- [ ] No executable workflow data, expression, script, permission, trigger, assertion, or user-facing output changes.
- [ ] Focused workflow-contract tests and repository gates pass.

## Verification
Run the recorded deterministic commands. Review every removed or rewritten block against its Scope row; that semantic review is authoritative for concision and preservation.
